Area Printing® by Seurat changes everything.

It’s a seismic shift that finally makes reshoring high-volume metal manufacturing possible. 

 

As an American-born and built contract manufacturer, Seurat prints your metal parts for you. Seurat provides serial production of high-volume, industrial-scale parts using its proprietary Area Printing® technology. Freeing you to focus on your business without compromises between high fidelity and high throughput, between design and costs, and between production and planet. 

 

Best of all, Seurat's Area Printing is about more than the plans you have now—it’s about innovations you haven’t even dreamed up yet. See what happens when you Scale Your Possible.

Scale Your Possible with future-ready metal contract manufacturing.

From our partners:

Seurat’s potential to disrupt and decarbonize the traditional metal parts manufacturing industry is tremendous. We have been impressed from the early days of the company by James and his team’s technical expertise and acumen to build a highly scalable business, with applicability across numerous industries. We are excited to participate in this round of funding, which will enable the company to ramp up production capabilities at greater scale and ultimately grow its client base.

• Capricorn Investment Group

Accelerated computing is unlocking new capabilities within the manufacturing industry, while creating a path toward sustainability. Seurat’s green approach to manufacturing will help transform industry standards.

• NVentures | Nvidia

Cubit Capital invests in courageous leaders building businesses that confront meaningful problems. James and the team at Seurat have endeavored to change metal manufacturing as we know it and introduce the next era of scalable 3D metal printing. We are thrilled to join the world-class team in this mission.

• Cubit Capital

Seurat has an innovative concept and technologies for metal additive manufacturing, and Honda has high expectations for their future potential. The metal additive manufacturing technology will enable the enhancement of the value of products through innovative design, and as Honda strives to create the joy and freedom of mobility, we envision that this technology will be necessary for us. Honda will continue to search for, collaborate with and invest in companies with a promising future through our global open innovation program.

• Honda Motor

James and the Seurat team have scaled fundamental science and engineering challenges, paving the way for large scale area printing factories capable of handling multiple metals. Built to print parts ranging from miniature precision consumer electronics to large complex machines for automotive, energy, and aerospace applications, their technology leads the world toward a new phase of sustainable, low-carbon, high-volume metal manufacturing.

• True Ventures

Seurat’s 3D metal printing process can enable the auto industry to produce parts for series production with flexibility, quality, and speed. Seurat’s local factory deployment model provides the industry with a solution to near-shore manufacturing and to increase the resiliency of supply chains. We're excited to be a part of that.

• Porsche Automobil Holding SE

The Area Printing® Technology is a game changer in Additive Manufacturing. Conservatively speaking the technology offers the potential for Siemens Energy to increase the throughput of Additive Manufacturing parts by a factor of 10 over the next years.

• Siemens Energy
